---
title: "Bangladesh Governance Trust Survey"
---

## How to embed the survey button in any Quarto page

Place the code block below anywhere in your `.qmd` file where you want the button to appear.

---

### Option A — Opens survey in a new tab (simplest)

```{=html}
<a href="bangladesh-trust-survey.html" target="_blank"
   style="display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;
          background:#006A4E; color:#fff; font-family:sans-serif;
          font-size:0.95rem; font-weight:500; padding:12px 24px;
          border-radius:8px; text-decoration:none;
          box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(0,106,78,0.35);
          transition:background 0.2s;">
  <svg width="18" height="18" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24"
       stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"
          d="M9 12h6m-3-3v6m-7 4h14a2 2 0 002-2V7a2 2 0 00-2-2H5
             a2 2 0 00-2 2v10a2 2 0 002 2z"/>
  </svg>
  Take the Governance Trust Survey
</a>
```

---

### Option B — Opens survey in an inline iframe modal (embedded, no page leave)

```{=html}
<!-- Trigger button -->
<button onclick="document.getElementById('surveyModal').style.display='flex'"
        style="display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;
               background:#006A4E; color:#fff; font-family:sans-serif;
               font-size:0.95rem; font-weight:500; padding:12px 24px;
               border-radius:8px; border:none; cursor:pointer;
               box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(0,106,78,0.35);">
  <svg width="18" height="18" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24"
       stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"
          d="M9 12h6m-3-3v6m-7 4h14a2 2 0 002-2V7a2 2 0 00-2-2H5
             a2 2 0 00-2 2v10a2 2 0 002 2z"/>
  </svg>
  Take the Governance Trust Survey
</button>

<!-- Modal overlay -->
<div id="surveyModal"
     style="display:none; position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:9999;
            background:rgba(0,0,0,0.6); align-items:center;
            justify-content:center; padding:20px;">
  <div style="background:white; border-radius:14px; width:100%;
              max-width:780px; height:90vh; overflow:hidden;
              display:flex; flex-direction:column;
              box-shadow:0 8px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.35);">
    <!-- Modal header bar -->
    <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between;
                padding:12px 18px; background:#006A4E; border-radius:14px 14px 0 0;">
      <span style="color:white; font-family:sans-serif; font-size:0.9rem; font-weight:500;">
        Bangladesh Governance Trust Survey 2026
      </span>
      <button onclick="document.getElementById('surveyModal').style.display='none'"
              style="background:rgba(255,255,255,0.2); border:none; color:white;
                     border-radius:6px; padding:4px 10px; cursor:pointer;
                     font-size:0.85rem; font-family:sans-serif;">
        ✕ Close
      </button>
    </div>
    <!-- Embedded survey -->
    <iframe src="bangladesh-trust-survey.html"
            style="flex:1; border:none; width:100%;"
            title="Bangladesh Governance Trust Survey">
    </iframe>
  </div>
</div>
```

---

> **File placement:** Put `bangladesh-trust-survey.html` in the same folder as your `.qmd` file (or your Quarto `_site/` output directory). Quarto will copy it as a passthrough resource.
>
> Add this to your `_quarto.yml` to ensure the file is copied during render:
> ```yaml
> resources:
>   - bangladesh-trust-survey.html
> ```
